mechanism: Infliximab increases tuberculosis (TB) reactivation risk in patients on isoniazid prophylaxis, as TNF-alpha inhibitors significantly impair cell-mediated immunity required for TB control.
action: Ensure active TB is excluded with tuberculin skin testing or IGRA before starting infliximab; if isoniazid prophylaxis is needed, start it at least 3 weeks before infliximab initiation and continue for 9 months, with close monitoring for TB symptoms.
